body.purpose: Controls, records, descriptions, and supporting copy.

shadows.name: field-focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Tight focus feedback on inputs, selects, and textareas.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Background and one-pixel position feedback on buttons; position movement is removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Runs the primary analyze or recalculate action at the end of the import form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent, #087f6a); color: white; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 720; padding: 11px 14px; transition: background 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-dark, #056554); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #63b9a6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Re-imports the selected files after a calculation already exists.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid #bfd0ca; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--accent-dark, #056554); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 720; padding: 11px 14px; transition: background 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent-pale, #e1f2ed); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #63b9a6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Reversibly includes or removes a transaction without turning the action into a destructive red control.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--accent-dark, #056554); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 720; padding: 8px 10px; transition: background 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-text:hover { background: var(--accent-pale, #e1f2ed); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #63b9a6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-text:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact neutral field used for currency and editable split amounts.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #4d5a55; font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 760; } .ds-field { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #cfd6d1; border-radius: 7px; outline: none; background: white; color: var(--ink, #17201d); padding: 9px 10px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #bfd0ca; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #087f6a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(8 127 106 / 12%); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #63b9a6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Allocation Select
components.description: Assigns a transaction evenly or to either participant.
components.css: .ds-select-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #4d5a55; font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 760; } .ds-select { width: 100%; min-width: 138px; border: 1px solid #cfd6d1; border-radius: 7px; outline: none; background: white; color: var(--ink, #17201d); padding: 9px 10px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: #bfd0ca; } .ds-select:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #087f6a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(8 127 106 / 12%); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #63b9a6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: API Status Pill
components.description: Desktop-only compact environment status in the application header.
components.css: .ds-api-status { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #c5d4ce; border-radius: 999px; color: #486158; font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 7px 11px; }

components.name: Ledger Panel
components.description: Flat paper container used for both import controls and results.
components.html:
Import activity

Upload AmEx CSV exports and tune the matching rules.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(113 127 120 / 34%); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel, #fffefa); color: var(--ink, #17201d); font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-heading { padding: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d8ddd8); } .ds-panel-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-panel-heading p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #68736e); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Error Alert
components.description: Concise recoverable validation or API failure above the workspace.
components.html: Choose at least one American Express CSV file.
components.css: .ds-error { border: 1px solid #efb7b0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--danger-bg, #fff0ed); color: var(--danger, #9c2f27); font-family: "Manrope Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 15px; }

narrative.overview:
Cost Splitter is a calm household reconciliation worksheet: a practical paper-and-ink surface where imported charges become a compact, inspectable ledger. Warm paper, near-black ink, hairline rules, and one restrained grocery-green action color make the arithmetic feel trustworthy. The interface is made for finishing a real household task, not for resembling a generic finance dashboard.

The direction was resolved from concept seed 25bb4377 as the sixth grounded candidate. Its system-level comparator is the concept roll's deployable-sheet board: a finish bar for linked structure and responsive transformation, not a source of aerospace styling. The shipped system keeps imports, transactions, allocations, and totals visibly connected while remaining quiet enough for repeated use.

The experience tells a working story: set the import terms, reveal every piece of evidence, resolve exceptions, and close the ledger with exact totals. Progress stays visible without hiding the charges that produced it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, flat worksheet surfaces with precise hairline separation.
Dense but readable transaction evidence and tabular monetary figures.
Restrained green reserved for actions, focus, selection, and inclusion.
Desktop accounting tables that become complete transaction cards on mobile.
Explicit loading, error, empty, included, unmatched, and removed states.

rules.name: The One Annotation Pen Rule
rules.body: Green is the only routine accent; it signals available action, focus, selection, or confirmed inclusion and never decorates neutral data.

rules.name: The Evidence Stays Ink Rule
rules.body: Totals and transaction amounts remain neutral ink, including negative values. Meaning comes from labels, signs, and position rather than financial red/green coding.

rules.name: The Arithmetic Holds Still Rule
rules.body: Monetary figures use tabular numerals and never animate through intermediate values that could imply a false calculation.

rules.name: The One Sans Voice Rule
rules.body: Manrope carries headings, labels, controls, records, and totals; monospace is an editing aid, not a second brand voice.

rules.name: The Phase Spacing Rule
rules.body: Space expands between import, summary, included, and unmatched phases; rows remain compact so comparisons are fast.

rules.name: The Ledger Must Unfold Rule
rules.body: Mobile changes the transaction grammar instead of clipping or horizontally scrolling the desktop table.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Panels, tables, metrics, and transaction cards rest on the page without shadows; borders and paper tones carry structure.

rules.name: The State-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation appears only as focus or hover feedback and must disappear when the interaction ends.

rules.name: The One Pill Rule
rules.body: Pill geometry belongs to the compact API status only; ordinary buttons, fields, panels, and records keep the ledger's modest corner language.

dos: Do keep imported charges inspectable, editable, attributable to their source file, and reversible.
Do preserve exact currency and half-cent display behavior with tabular numerals.
Do keep semantic headings, direct labels, fieldsets where grouping applies, native form affordances, keyboard operation, visible focus, and at least 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.
Do keep loading, validation, empty, included, unmatched, removed, and re-included states explicit.
Do verify that a 390px viewport has no document-level horizontal overflow and contains at least one complete transaction record.

Do verify production captures without framework chrome; desktop must show the full working hierarchy and dense ledger without clipped labels or values, and the import, edit, remove, and re-include flow must produce no application console warnings or errors.
donts: Don't turn the worksheet into a generic finance dashboard, decorative marketing page, or aerospace interface.
Don't hide the evidence behind an opaque total or detach summary figures from the records that produce them.
Don't use color alone to communicate destructive, included, matched, or unmatched state; actions keep explicit words.
Don't force the desktop table into a clipped or document-scrolling mobile viewport.
Don't add resting shadows, gratuitous pills, celebratory effects, or animated arithmetic.
Don't imply that uploaded files are stored; the implemented flow keeps them in memory for the requested calculation.
